title: Rescue line lite · Level 3: Ramp and debris
brief: A 7 x 4-tile course of 300 mm tiles (a black line about 19 mm wide on white), laid by the simulator's map builder from the library's tiles: level 2's course - the Start tile, two 100 mm gaps on straights (#11), a T junction (#70) whose green marker turns the robot right-angled off its arm (its third arm a short spur ending at a tile edge, never on the route), and a crossing (#80) driven twice, each time turned by a green marker (25 mm squares) - with a loop through two more columns: a 15-degree ramp up one tile to a raised corner 80 mm high, and a 15-degree ramp down the next tile; a speed bump 10 mm high across the line, and three 3 mm dowels 240 mm long across it; round corners of radius 150 mm, and the Goal tile: one route with no dead end, 6.26 m of line. The robot starts on the Start tile on the line, facing along it, moved up to 10 mm sideways and turned up to 5 degrees (run 1 too). The robot is the class robot (Configure robot's default: four downward colour sensors 24 and 48 mm ahead, 16 mm either side) with an IMU on I2C 8 lying flat, fixed by the level (imu.tilt()[0] is the pitch); a run on a changed robot is not this level's. The RCJ referee judges the run: a tile is reached in order (5.4.6), and a lack of progress is called when the robot passes the next tile's exit off the line (5.5.1b) or takes a wrong line (5.5.1c); the robot is then put back on the Start tile and the start button pressed for it. A run ends when the robot reaches the Goal tile, at the third lack of progress, or after 180 s. Score: 60 x the fraction of the line completed (the progress along it, never past the tiles reached in order and the robot's front), + 20 x min(1, par / time) if it reached the Goal, + 20 if no lack of progress was called. Par 42.3 s (the markers reference's mean). Pass: a mean of at least 60 over the 5 runs, and at least 4 of 5 runs reach the Goal.

score.run: 60 * fraction + if(goal, 20 * min(1, par / goalTime), 0) + if(lops == 0, 20, 0)
score.summary: round(sum(r in runs: r.points) / count(r in runs: true), 1)

pass: sum(r in runs: r.points) / count(r in runs: true) >= 60 & count(r in runs: r.goal) >= 0.8 * n
